Juan Ramos Full Stack Developer CV — page 2

facts.text: Juan Paolo Ramos is described in the CV as a Full Stack Developer with 7 years of experience designing, building, and delivering web and cross-platform applications end to end.
The CV identifies React, Angular, and TypeScript as frontend strengths.
The CV identifies Node.js and Python as backend service technologies.
The CV identifies PostgreSQL, MySQL, NoSQL, and Supabase for data management.
The CV describes AWS experience in cloud infrastructure, deployment, and scalable application development.
The CV describes building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, integration, deployment, and release workflows.
The CV describes implementing row-level security, database triggers, and audit logging.
The CV describes third-party REST API and webhook integrations and real-time data synchronization.
The CV describes AI-assisted development and production-ready LLM-powered features.
The CV describes translating complex business requirements into technical solutions for non-technical stakeholders.
The CV lists these frontend skills: React, Angular, Vue.js, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, React Native / Expo, Electron, responsive and mobile-first UI.
The CV lists these backend skills: Node.js, Express, NestJS, Java, Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, GraphQL, webhooks and event-trigger systems.
The CV lists these cloud skills: AWS Lambda, EC2, S3, ECS, IAM and CloudWatch; Google Cloud; Azure.
The CV lists these databases skills: PostgreSQL, Supabase Auth, row-level security, Realtime, Edge Functions, database triggers, functions, append-only audit design, MySQL, MongoDB and Redis.
The CV lists these devops skills: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD, Linux and deployment automation.
The CV lists these integrations skills: Third-party REST APIs, webhook and email-parsing pipelines, CRM/automation APIs, Twilio SMS/voice, Google Calendar API, Stripe/payment-link APIs.
The CV lists these security skills: OpenID Connect, OAuth2, JWT, role-based access control, least privilege, audit trails and secure SDLC.
The CV lists these ai skills: OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, RAG pipelines, natural-language querying, structured output validation, Claude Code, Cursor and GitHub Copilot.
The CV lists these testing skills: Pytest, Jest, Playwright, TDD, Git, Jira, documentation and maintenance guides.
Chewy: Senior Full-Stack Developer - Web, AI and Integrations (2023–2026).
At Chewy, the stated project was unified AI-assisted product front ends connected to Node and Python services on PostgreSQL.
At Chewy, built responsive React and Next.js front ends over Node.js and Python FastAPI back ends for customer-facing and internal workflows.
At Chewy, integrated third-party REST APIs, webhooks, and MCP fulfilment servers, handling contacts, conversations, and event-driven automations across services.
At Chewy, modeled PostgreSQL and pgvector schemas with row-level security and audit-oriented design to scope access by role.
At Chewy, shipped RAG-grounded natural-language querying and token-streamed responses as production AI features.
At Chewy, added real-time updates and OpenTelemetry tracing to support multi-user changes and debug non-deterministic failures under load.
At Chewy, drove pytest and Playwright test automation, documented setup and maintenance, and refined features with product stakeholders.
Nature's Path Foods: Full-Stack Engineer - Pricing, CRM and Integrations (2021–2023).
At Nature's Path Foods, the stated project was a Price Management SaaS and merchant CRM with third-party and finance integration.
At Nature's Path Foods, built configurable price management software with dynamic data-driven pricing calculations for sales quotes instead of manual spreadsheets.

At Nature's Path Foods, integrated a merchant CRM bidirectionally with finance and supply-chain systems using REST and OData to synchronize contacts and transactions and automate month-end reconciliation.
At Nature's Path Foods, implemented OpenID Connect, SAML SSO, role-based access, and LDAP / Active Directory integration for least-privilege access.
At Nature's Path Foods, integrated third-party services using Oracle Service Bus, JMS, SOAP and REST interfaces.
Drawboard: Full-Stack Developer - Client Application Delivery (2020–2021).
At Drawboard, the stated project was a business-critical client application and services supporting 10k+ users.
At Drawboard, delivered and supported a cross-platform client application for 10k+ users, emphasizing performance and offline-capable field use.
At Drawboard, owned 24x7 reliability using real-time monitoring, change control, and rehearsed rollback.
At Drawboard, collaborated with stakeholders on change scope, mentored new team members, and maintained handover documentation.
The CV lists Nanyang Technological University, Bachelor of Computer Science (BCompSc), 2020.

conflicts.description: The CV documents mentoring new team members at Drawboard but does not specify formal people-management responsibility, number of direct reports, or hiring authority.
conflicts.resolution: Do not claim formal engineering manager experience or a team size without additional verified evidence.

conflicts.description: Employment periods are specified by year only, not by month. Exact durations and whether roles overlapped cannot be established from the CV.
conflicts.resolution: Quote the year ranges as written and do not infer exact start/end months.
